**v1.8.1: when the bot doesn't turn your wizard with the mouse, it now says why - and a few things that kept it from trying are fixed.**
- **What was wrong.** You saw the bot stop turning with the mouse. Without a log the cause isn't known yet, and several ways of not using the mouse wrote nothing to debug.log: the setting off, the wizard just setting off, the facing not read from the game's memory before or during a turn, and the walker not steering by the game's memory at all (the mouse is only measured on a turn steered by it). When three tries in a row didn't turn the wizard, the bot left the mouse alone for 10 minutes and said so only in debug.log. Those three tries could all come within a few seconds, and a try whose facing read failed wasn't counted, so it could come back at every small correction. Above 5x (speedhack), the mouse was refused instead of the turn being made at 1x as the Settings help says. The tray's "Speedhack: press its ... key in 3 s" counted the game as sped up even with the speedhack off. Words in the bot's own notice over the game (its OK button, the Wizard101 Central line) could read as a game window and stop mouse turns while it sat at the top middle of the game. Windows+4 (the overlay) was taken from every program while the bot ran.
- **When a mouse turn is tried and not made, debug.log now says why**, once a minute for each reason: "Walk: mouse steering: not now - <why>", "... the facing couldn't be read (<why>) - A/D", "... off (Settings: Turn with the mouse while walking)", "... waiting for the game's memory (<why>)" (it isn't walking by the game's memory, so the mouse isn't tried; said once and when it changes), "... you took the keyboard or mouse mid-turn ...".
- **The 10-minute pause is shown.** debug.log and the Dashboard's log say it each time ("Walk: mouse steering off for 10 minutes - ..."), and the first time in a run a tray tip does too, with which half failed: "the game didn't take the right-button drag" (the cursor stayed shown before and after the slide), "the game took the drag but the wizard didn't turn" (it hid), or "the wizard's facing couldn't be read from the game's memory mid-turn (<why>)" (then send the log lines it names), and what to try: check your wizard turns when you right-drag yourself, or untick Settings > Lock my mouse while the bot uses it for one run. A measuring try that misses now waits 10 s before the next, and one whose facing read failed counts as a miss.
- **When the drag doesn't reach the game** (the cursor shown before and after), the bot logs once which window is under the point it presses at, then tries that press once more with the right button pressed the raw way, with the mouse lock leaving that one button alone for the moment (your moves, other buttons and wheel stay locked; F6 and the watchdog work as before). If that turns the wizard, it presses that way for the rest of the run and says so.
- **Above 5x** (speedhack) a mouse turn now puts the game to 1x first, as an A/D turn does, instead of not using the mouse. Big turns are still made on the spot above 5x, as before, not walking on. The tray's speedhack key items now change the bot's idea of the game's speed only with the speedhack setting on.
- **The bot's own windows.** Words inside the bot's own windows over the game (its notice, the party window) no longer stop a mouse turn; nothing is hidden for it, so nothing flickers and you still see and can screen-share them. If one of those windows (or any other) is right under the point the bot presses at, the mouse isn't used for that turn (A/D turns the wizard, as before) and the log names that window. A word that does stop it is logged with where it was.
- **Windows+4** now toggles the overlay only while Wizard101 is the window in front; in your other programs the key is theirs again. Other keys are unchanged.
- **If the mouse still isn't used,** send AutoFarmer\debug.log, or at least its "Walk: mouse steering:" lines and the "Walk: the last minute: ... (N by the mouse)" lines (N is how many turns the mouse made that minute). A "mouse steering: off for 10 minutes - ..." line or the tray tip says which half failed. No "mouse steering:" line at all and N = 0: also send the "Walk: the game's memory ..." and "Vision:" lines. AutoFarmer\LIVE_CHECKS.txt step 2.9 lists what to look for.
- **Not tried in the game yet.** The raw-press retry and the window checks were only read, not run against the game.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
